verses.text: Praise Yah! Praise God in his sanctuary! Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power!
lines: Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power!

verses.text: Praise him for his mighty acts! Praise him according to his excellent greatness!
lines: Praise him for his mighty acts!
Praise him according to his excellent greatness!

verses.text: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet! Praise him with harp and lyre!
lines: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet!
Praise him with harp and lyre!

verses.text: Praise him with tambourine and dancing! Praise him with stringed instruments and flute!
lines: Praise him with tambourine and dancing!
Praise him with stringed instruments and flute!

verses.text: Praise him with loud cymbals! Praise him with resounding cymbals!
Let everything that has breath praise Yah! Praise Yah!
lines: Let everything that has breath praise Yah!
